en: Ops-Core RAILINK powered rails with Battery Pack+

Ops-Core ARC rails with the RAILINK Battery Pack+ (six AA lithium cells) on the back of the helmet; they carry power and data to the devices on the rails. They take the place of the helmet's own rails and headset mount: a helmet headset, the F-PANO goggle and two ARC rail adapters fit on them. With the rails on, the helmet takes no other night vision device; the F-PANO gets its power from them.
ch: Ops-Core RAILINK 供电导轨（带 Battery Pack+ 电池盒）
Ops-Core ARC 导轨，后部带 RAILINK Battery Pack+ 电池盒（6 节 AA 锂电池），沿导轨为上面的设备供电、传输数据。它取代头盔自带的导轨和耳机座：上面可以装头盔耳机、F-PANO 夜视仪和两个 ARC 导轨转接座。装上导轨后，头盔不能再装其他夜视仪；F-PANO 由它供电。

en: The RAILINK system's battery pack, six AA lithium cells, worn on the back of the helmet. It powers everything on the rails; the F-PANO gives no picture without it.
ch: Ops-Core RAILINK Battery Pack+ 电池盒
RAILINK 系统的电池盒，装 6 节 AA 锂电池，挂在头盔后部，为导轨上的所有设备供电。没有它，F-PANO 放下也没有画面。

en: The mount that holds the F-PANO goggle on a RAILINK helmet: height, tilt and fore-aft adjustment, and a flip-up hinge. It fits only the RAILINK rails' mount.
ch: 把 F-PANO 夜视仪固定在装有 RAILINK 导轨的头盔上的支架，可调高低、俯仰、前后，可以向上翻起。只能装在 RAILINK 导轨的支架位上。

en: L3Harris F-PANO fused panoramic night vision goggles

Fused Panoramic Night Vision Goggle: the four-tube, 97 degree panoramic goggle with a thermal channel added. Four white phosphor image intensifier tubes; a small thermal camera above the right inner tube lays its picture over that tube's image. Comes on its own adjustable, flip-up helmet mount; fits the helmets that take the RAILINK rails, and the rails themselves. It is powered by the RAILINK rails: without them on the helmet it gives no picture.
ch: L3Harris F-PANO 融合全景夜视仪
融合全景夜视仪：在四管、97 度视场的全景夜视仪上加了一路热成像。四支白磷像增强管；右侧内管上方有一台小型热像仪，它的画面叠加在这根管的图像上。自带可调、可上翻的头盔支架；可装在能装 RAILINK 导轨的头盔上，也可直接装在导轨上。由 RAILINK 导轨供电：头盔上没有导轨时没有画面。
